🇬🇧 🇦🇷 🇮🇱 The International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea, seated in Hamburg, rejected Argentina’s application to prohibit drilling operations near the Falkland (Malvinas) Islands by a majority of 18 to 3. The Tribunal ruled that it lacked the jurisdiction to adjudicate matters of sovereignty. The project in question is being undertaken by Israeli and British companies. President Javier Milei of Argentina stated that the nation respects the ruling, whilst stressing that “this is not the final word”. He affirmed that the Argentine government will persist in its endeavours to prevent the exploitation of natural resources in the region, reiterating that “the Malvinas Islands belong to Argentina”.
